# ramble_resource (Resource)

A pack or job published to a Ramble registry.

Ramble fetches the content of each version from the repository in the background. A failed fetch does not fail the resource: Terraform manages the registry entry, not the fetch.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A pack published to the registry under a user or organisation namespace.
resource "ramble_resource" "mysql" {
  namespace      = "alice"
  name           = "mysql"
  type           = "pack"
  repository_url = "https://github.com/alice/packs"
  file_path      = "packs/mysql"
  description    = "MySQL on Nomad"
  license        = "MIT"
  tags           = ["database", "sql"]

  # Changing the version later adds it to the resource.
  version = "v1.0.0"
}

# Configure a repository webhook to publish new versions.
output "webhook_url" {
  value = ramble_resource.mysql.webhook_url
}

output "webhook_secret" {
  value     = ramble_resource.mysql.webhook_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the pack or job. Changing it replaces the resource; a change of letter case only does not, because Ramble compares names case-insensitively.
- `namespace` (String) Username or organisation that owns the resource. Changing it replaces the resource; a change of letter case only does not, because Ramble compares namespaces case-insensitively.
- `repository_url` (String) Git repository the content is fetched from. Ramble accepts `https` URLs on its allowed git hosts and answers any other value with an error.
- `type` (String) Either `pack` or `job`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `version` (String) The version to publish, 1-64 characters. On create it is the initial version. Changing it later adds that version to the resource; the resource is not replaced and older versions stay. Setting a version that already exists is accepted. The value is never overwritten from Ramble, so versions added by webhooks do not cause a difference; see `latest_version` for what Ramble currently reports. After an import it is set to `latest_version`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Short description. Empty by default.
- `file_path` (String) Path of the pack or job inside the repository. Empty by default.
- `license` (String) SPDX licence identifier. When omitted Ramble detects the licence from the repository, or records `Unknown`. Removing the attribute later keeps the current value; set it explicitly to change it.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags. Each tag must be lowercase, 2-20 characters of `a-z`, `0-9` and `-`. Empty by default.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `id` (String) Ramble's numeric id of the resource.
- `latest_version` (String) The latest version Ramble knows of, including versions added by webhooks.
- `webhook_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret for the webhook. Ramble returns it only when the resource is created, so it is `null` for an imported resource. To get a new secret, replace the resource (`terraform apply -replace`).
- `webhook_url` (String) URL the repository calls to publish new versions.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by namespace and name. The webhook secret is not returned by Ramble,
# so it is null after an import.
terraform import ramble_resource.mysql alice/mysql
```
